verdict.rationale: Asana's MCP server and 'Asana Dash' (AI Chief of Staff) let users ask natural-language questions and get workspace-grounded answers/reports (e.g., 'Find all my incomplete tasks due this week', 'Generate reports and summaries based on Asana data'), which supports instant AI answers from workspace content. However, there is no explicit documentation of citation/source-attribution mechanics in answers. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of citation formatting/sourcing in AI answers, deeper Dash product documentation, and independent/hands-on confirmation of accuracy or citation behavior.
